theme: Small talk đầu giờ & pantry chat

vocab.meaning_vi: đi lấy/uống một ly cà phê nhanh
vocab.example: Do you want to grab a coffee before the standup starts?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có muốn đi lấy ly cà phê trước khi họp standup không?

vocab.example: Someone left a box of snacks in the pantry for the dev team.
vocab.example_vi: Có người để một hộp đồ ăn vặt trong pantry cho team dev.

vocab.example: After the release, I just want to chill out this weekend.
vocab.example_vi: Sau đợt release, cuối tuần này tôi chỉ muốn thư giãn.

vocab.example: I slept in on Sunday because I fixed bugs until late on Saturday.
vocab.example_vi: Chủ nhật tôi ngủ nướng vì tối thứ Bảy sửa bug đến khuya.

vocab.meaning_vi: chuyện tám, tin đồn ở công ty
vocab.example: Let's talk about the new coffee machine, not office gossip.
vocab.example_vi: Mình nói chuyện máy pha cà phê mới đi, đừng tám chuyện công ty.

vocab.example: We are having a team lunch on Friday to welcome the new tester.
vocab.example_vi: Thứ Sáu nhóm mình ăn trưa chung để chào đón bạn tester mới.

vocab.example: The backend team ordered bubble tea to celebrate the deployment.
vocab.example_vi: Team backend đặt trà sữa để ăn mừng đợt deploy.

vocab.example: Fun fact: our tech lead used to be a professional guitar player.
vocab.example_vi: Chuyện thú vị là: tech lead của mình từng là tay guitar chuyên nghiệp.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Morning, Linh! Are you here to grab a coffee too?

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Yes, I really need one. I didn't sleep well last night.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Oh no. Were you testing the new release late?

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: No, my neighbor's dog was barking until midnight. How was your weekend?

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Pretty quiet. I slept in on Saturday and then just chilled out at home.

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: That sounds perfect. By the way, did you see the snacks on the table?

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Yes, Minh brought them from his trip to Da Lat. The dried strawberries are great.

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Nice! Fun fact: I have never been to Da Lat.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Really? You should go. Are you joining the team lunch on Friday?

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Of course. I heard we are ordering bubble tea after lunch too.

questions.q: What did Nam do on Saturday?
options: He slept in and relaxed at home

shadowing: Good morning! Do you want to grab a coffee before the meeting?
How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun with your family?
I slept in on Sunday, so I feel much better today.
Someone left some snacks in the pantry, so please help yourself.
Are you free for a team lunch on Friday to welcome Hoa?
